newsitem.title: UK: PacifiCorp gets acceptances for Energy bid.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp gets acceptances for Energy bid.

text.p: U.S. group PacifiCorp said on Wednesday it had received acceptances representing 61.6 percent of Energy Group Plc under its agreed 3.7 billion stg bid for the British company.

As of 1400 GMT on Tuesday, the first closing date of the offer, PacifiCorp had valid acceptances for 243.79 million Energy Group shares and 19.33 million of the company's American Depositary Shares (ADSs).
Including its shares in Energy Group, Pacificorp owned or had acceptances for 328.56 million shares, representing some 63.1 percent of the British firm.
Earlier this month, the U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) made a second request for information as part of its routine review of the proposed merger. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
